name: CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp.
summary: CleanTech Vanadium Mining Corp. is an exploration-stage mining company that acquires, explores and develops mineral properties in the United States and Bolivia, exploring for vanadium, lead, zinc, gold and nickel. Its flagship project is the wholly owned Gibellini vanadium project in Nevada. Formerly Flying Nickel Mining Corp., it was incorporated in 2020 and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.
